config.description: Resolve scheduled base, source-keyed channel ownership and switch ranges. Synthetic inputs are accepted only with dry_run; that path has no state writes or hardware output.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: Only these lamps (default: all scheduled lamps).

test_now.name: Test time
test_now.description: Dry-run only: pretend it is this ISO time.

test_overrides.name: Test overrides
test_overrides.description: Dry-run only: use this override record instead of sensor.ls_overrides.

sequence.value_template: {{ dry_run|default(false) or ((test_now is not defined or not test_now) and test_overrides is not defined and not (force_all|default(false))) }}

variables.overrides: {{ test_overrides if dry_run|default(false) and test_overrides is defined else state_attr('sensor.ls_overrides','overrides') or {} }}

variables.plan: {% set wanted='on' if 'mode:sara' in active else 'off' %}{{ dict(baseline.schedule,base=baseline.targets,resolved=resolved,switches=switch_plan.switches,revision=revision,sara_mirror=(wanted if states('input_boolean.ls_sara_mode_mirror')!=wanted else none)) }}

variables.requested: {{ (lights if lights is list else [lights]) if lights|default(none) else [] }}
variables.lamp_targets: {% set n=namespace(t={}) %}{% for L,t in resolved.targets.items() if not t.is_room and (not requested or L in requested) %}{% set n.t=dict(n.t,**{L:t}) %}{% endfor %}{{ n.t }}

variables.ordinary: {% set n=namespace(t={}) %}{% for L,t in lamp_targets.items() if (L not in resolved.assignments or not t.on) and is_state(L,'on') and baseline.targets[L].get('send',true) %}{% set n.t=dict(n.t,**{L:t}) %}{% endfor %}{{ n.t }}

if.value_template: {{ revision==states.sensor.ls_overrides.last_updated.isoformat() and not is_state(L,'on' if switch.on else 'off') }}

sequence.note: Display only: mirror the effective block (override or schedule) into input_select.ls_<scope>_override so dashboards can highlight it. The engine never reads these selects.

sequence.alias: Display only: mirror Sara Mode (override record mode:sara) into input_boolean.ls_sara_mode_mirror so /house-lights can highlight it. The engine never reads it.

sequence.note: Next-block rule: overrides set before the scope's latest fade start fade out with the fade (see plan) and end once the new block is reached.

config.description: One stable override per control source and scope. Updates only supplied channels; effects claim their declared channels. Group activations share an effect instance. Room power is persistent state, never an override. Dry run returns proposed events/commands without changing state.

variables.allowed: {% set n=namespace(ok=revision==states.sensor.ls_overrides.last_updated.isoformat() and generation==state_attr('sensor.effects_controller','generation')) %}{% for L in command.owners %}{% if not is_state(L,'on') or (command.payload.get('state')!='OFF' and not (state_attr('sensor.ls_overrides','power') or {}).get(area_id(L),true)) %}{% set n.ok=false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% for E in command.members %}{% if not is_state(E,'on') %}{% set n.ok=false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ n.ok }}

variables.payload: {{ dict(payload,brightness=([1,[254,value|float]|min]|max)|round|int) if channel=='brightness' else dict(payload,**({'color_temp':(1000000/value.kelvin)|round|int} if 'kelvin' in value else {'color':{'rgb':value.rgb|join(',')}})) }}

{{ dict(payload,transition=(0.4 if target.brightness.kind=='effect' or target.color.kind=='effect' else target.get('transition',3))) if target.on else {'state':'OFF','transition':target.get('transition',3)} }}
variables.rows: {% set n=namespace(rows=rows) %}{% if is_state(lamp,'on') %}{% for E in catalog.members.get(lamp,[]) if is_state(E,'on') %}{% set n.rows=n.rows+[{'entity':E,'owner':lamp,'topic':catalog.topics[E],'payload':payload}] %}{% endfor %}{% endif %}{{ n.rows }}

config.description: Single queued writer. Source-keyed channel records merge per channel; no cross-scope deletion. Persistent power and range configuration are separate from expiring overrides.
